citation: Gopal et al., Journal of Biological Chemistry 279 (2004), 44522–44532
series: Fig. 9A, four distinguishable square markers for human SMCT expressed in Xenopus oocytes. The circles are mouse measurements. The fitted line combines species.
reading: Approximate paired readings, rounded to the nearest 5 pmol from the publisher's figure. The axes show integrated charge on x and uptake on y. Individual experimental uncertainties are unavailable.
evaluation: Fix n=2 from the Coady study, use measured human lactate uptake to predict net charge, and compare with the independently measured charge. The mouse series and propionate are excluded.
